caption_lead: Table 1: The nine compaction events recorded in the session that compacted most.
caption_tail: Each event carries kind, ts, summary, first_kept, kept, and tokens_before, so the system has a precise account of every compaction it performed. tokens_before is the serialized length of the pre-compaction message array as the system computed it, not a model tokenizer count. The worst case compresses 761,547 characters into a 1,764-character summary, a ratio of roughly 432 to 1.
